title: Exceptional spectral sparsities
statement: For every dimension $n$ and every function $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\{\pm1\}$, the number of nonzero vector Fourier coefficients of the real-valued function $x\mapsto f(x)$ does not belong to $\{2,3,5,6,7,9\}$.
